meta.name: PQ Doge Wallet
meta.shortDescription: Dogecoin wallet with libdogecoin (such, sendtx, spvnode), Falcon-512 PQ keys, SPV/SMPV, and optional Core RPC
meta.longDescription: Ships libdogecoin built with liboqs: `such` (P2PKH keys, Falcon-512 keygen, sign, commitments), `sendtx` (P2P broadcast), `spvnode` (headers + BIP37 + SMPV). The Go UI only shells out to `such` for keys and signing; it does not use btcd/btcsuite. P2PKH script hex for `such -c sign` is built from the libdogecoin pubkey using standard SHA256+RIPEMD160 (same template libdogecoin uses). Optional PQ keys via such, spvnode after wallet creation. JSON APIs for sign/broadcast/RPC. Optional MemeTracker and explorer. Set DOGE_RPC_URL for Core sendtoaddress/gettransaction when available.
